name: Live Order Desk
note: A Poisson order stream, thinned against an hourly intensity curve, feeds a DPR-aware canvas pace chart (today against the same weekday last week, a target shaped like it, and a projection that scales last week's curve), a ticker whose rows grow in through @starting-style on grid-template-rows, an hourly heatmap and FLIP-ranked items, all summed from the same order records; the loop sleeps off screen via IntersectionObserver. Set --dbe-live-h to 100dvh to run it as a full app screen.

name: Inventory Runway
note: Safety stock and reorder points are recomputed from an inverse-normal service level and a demand-uplift slider, re-ranking the SKU table with FLIP and redrawing an SVG runway with an uncertainty cone, PO arrivals and an order-by marker; drafted and submitted purchase orders flow back into every projection, and the need-action ring eases through registered @property gradient stops. Set --dbe-stock-h to 100dvh to run it as a full app screen.

name: Fulfilment Floor
note: A capacity-limited floor simulation (pickers, packers, carrier cut-offs) on a DPR-aware canvas: dots slide right as they age against each stage's SLA, staged orders stack like cartons in the truck bay and leave with the truck, and colour is slack against the cut-off; throughput and carrier views are summed from the same events. Set --dbe-fulfil-h to 100dvh to use it as a wallboard.

name: Regional Sales Map
note: A tile-grid map of the 50 states and DC built from CSS grid buttons and coloured from a single --t custom property through color-mix(in oklch), sequential or diverging for YoY; arrow keys move to the geographic neighbour, legend steps isolate their states through :has(), and rankings, small multiples with a shared crosshair and the detail panel read the same 24 months. Set --dbe-regions-h to 100dvh for a full page.

name: Basket & Free-Shipping Lab
note: Dragging the free-shipping line (a role=slider handle over the basket histogram) re-runs a counterfactual on every order's pre-nudge basket, projecting AOV, free-shipping share, shipping P&L and net contribution, while a registered @property tints the result toward gain or loss; the category mix bars and lift matrix come from the same orders. Set --dbe-basket-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Returns Mosaic
note: A Marimekko mosaic in SVG (column width is a category's share of returns, block height a reason's share) with dashed outlines on reasons running at least 1.35x their store-wide share, a diverging size-fit chart apportioned exactly from the same counts, and an RMA queue whose row highlight and bulk bar are driven by :has(). Set --dbe-returns-h to 100dvh to run it full screen.

name: Product Margin Matrix
note: Each product's contribution is built from list price down through discount, COGS, shipping, payment fees and returns, plotted as a log-scale bubble matrix whose bubbles glide between periods (nodes are updated in place, never re-inserted, so their CSS transitions survive) against a draggable target-margin line; the waterfall and sortable table share the same numbers. Set --dbe-margin-h to 100dvh for a full-screen view.

name: Checkout Butterfly
note: A butterfly funnel in SVG, mobile growing left and desktop right from a shared spine of steps, with drop-off wedges between steps and exit reasons apportioned by largest remainder so they sum exactly to the sessions lost; a rolling-rate trend marks a wallet launch and a payment outage, and the payments view reconciles orders to attempts. Set --dbe-checkout-h to 100dvh to fill a screen.
